# NEW 2026-11-18 1337 start S4 (events of the first two years, oe_s37_). Generated by gen_start_1337_events.py; edit the generator, not this file.
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_s37_ev_pulse } }
yearly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_s37_crown_ai } }

# BYZ. The first pulse decides once whether this is the 1337 start; then monthly while the schedule is on.
oe_s37_ev_pulse = {
    trigger = {
        tag = BYZ
        OR = {
            has_variable = oe_s37_ev_on
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_s37_ev_init }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_s37_ev_init } }
            set_variable = oe_s37_ev_init
            if = {
                limit = { current_date < 1337.6.1 }
                set_variable = oe_s37_ev_on
                set_variable = { name = oe_s37_ev_m value = 0 }
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_s37_ev_on } oe_s37_ev_monthly = yes }
    }
}
# AI Byzantium crowns John V co-emperor: yearly 25 % while the action is allowed and the authority is at least 30.
oe_s37_crown_ai = {
    trigger = {
        tag = BYZ
        is_ai = yes
        exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars
        oe_s37_crown_ok = yes
        international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { has_variable = oe_pillars_authority var:oe_pillars_authority >= 30 }
    }
    effect = { random = { chance = 25 oe_s37_crown_do = yes } }
}
